item.title: 苹果确认 10 月 28 日在洛杉矶举办「Pro and tell」活动
item.guid: 苹果确认-10-月-28-日在洛杉矶举办「Pro-and-tell」活动
item.description:
Apple announced on October 19 that it will hold a "Pro and tell" event in Los Angeles on October 28 (Beijing time, October 29 at 1:00 AM). iFanr has also received the event invitation and will provide first-hand coverage. 苹果 10 月 19 日宣布，将于 10 月 28 日（北京时间 10 月 29 日凌晨 1:00）在洛杉矶举办「Pro and tell」活动，爱范儿也已同步收到活动邀请函，届时将带来第一手报道。

The event is expected to unveil Apple's first touchscreen MacBook Pro and new iPad products. 活动预计将带来苹果首款触屏 MacBook Pro 与 iPad 新品。

item.title: 中国手机三季度出货量创 14 年同期新低，华为与苹果份额合计超四成
item.guid: 中国手机三季度出货量创-14-年同期新低，华为与苹果份额合计超四成
item.description:
Preliminary data released by Counterpoint Research on October 19 indicates that China's smartphone shipments in the third quarter of 2026 decreased by 10% year-on-year, falling to their lowest level for the same period since 2012. The agency attributes the market decline to increased material costs due to rising storage prices and exacerbated supply shortages. Counterpoint Research 10 月 19 日发布的初步数据表明，2026 年第三季度中国智能手机出货量同比下降 10%，降至自 2012 年以来的同期最低水平。该机构将市场下滑归因于存储价格上涨带来的物料成本增加，以及供应短缺加剧。

Huawei ranked first with a 21.3% market share, with shipments growing by 19% year-on-year. Counterpoint believes that relatively stable prices in the early part of the quarter, along with strong sales performance from the Changxiang, nova, and Mate product lines, supported this growth; however, Huawei's price increase starting in September may put pressure on subsequent sales. 华为以 21.3% 的份额位居第一，出货量同比增长 19%。Counterpoint 认为，季度前期相对稳定的价格，以及畅享、nova 和 Mate 产品线的销售表现支撑了增长；华为自 9 月起涨价，则可能给后续销售带来压力。

Apple ranked second with a 19.5% share. The report states that sales of the iPhone 18 Pro series in the Chinese market during the first three weeks after launch increased by 23.5% compared to the previous generation's Pro series in the same period; the delayed release of the base model also prompted some consumers to switch to Pro models. This initial sales data uses a different statistical scope than the full-quarter shipments. 苹果以 19.5% 的份额排名第二。报告称，iPhone 18 Pro 系列上市前三周在中国市场的销量，比上一代 Pro 系列同期增长 23.5%；基础款延后发布，也促使部分消费者转向 Pro 机型。这项首发销量数据与全季出货量采用不同统计范围。

The combined share of the two manufacturers exceeded 40%. Counterpoint pointed out that in response to rising component prices, other Android manufacturers are adjusting their product portfolios by adding Pro Max models, launching lower-priced models, or delaying standard versions; consumer behavior such as delaying phone upgrades, waiting for promotions, or switching to refurbished phones may continue to suppress demand in the fourth quarter. 两家厂商的份额合计超过四成。Counterpoint 指出，面对零部件涨价，其他安卓厂商正通过增加 Pro Max、推出更低价机型或推迟标准版等方式调整产品组合；消费者延后换机、等待促销或转向翻新机的行为，可能继续压制第四季度需求。

item.title: 豆包刘星回应「国内过半算力造爽剧」：字节约 10% 用于视频模型
item.guid: 豆包刘星回应「国内过半算力造爽剧」：字节约-10%-用于视频模型
item.description:
On October 19, Liu Xing, head of public relations for Doubao, responded to the claim that "over half of domestic computing power is used to create 'shuāngjù' (binge-worthy dramas)," stating that the relevant computing power data is "somewhat unreliable." He said that only about 10% of ByteDance's total computing power is used for training and inference of video generation models. 10 月 19 日，豆包公关负责人刘星回应「国内超一半算力在造爽剧」的说法，称相关算力数据「有些不靠谱」。他表示，字节跳动总算力中，只有约 10% 用于视频生成模型的训练和推理。

Screenshots of Liu Xing's original post published by Red Star News show that he simultaneously marked "false" on two circulating news report screenshots. These screenshots cited an investor relations activity record, listing short dramas and video generation as the scenarios with the largest AI token consumption. 红星新闻刊出的刘星原帖截图显示，他同时在流传的两张报道截图上标注了「不实」。这些截图援引一份投资者关系活动记录，将短剧与视频生成列为 AI Token 消耗最大的场景。

The proportion provided by Liu Xing is based on ByteDance's total computing power, including both model training and inference, and does not attribute all of this computing power to short drama production. 刘星给出的比例以字节总算力为范围，同时包含模型训练和推理，并未把这部分算力全部归为短剧制作。

item.title: OpenAI 为 OpenCode 受攻击用户退还被消耗的 API 额度
item.guid: OpenAI-为-OpenCode-受攻击用户退还被消耗的-API-额度
item.description:
On October 19, Tibo Sottiaux, a member of OpenAI's Codex and ChatGPT team, stated that the team has partnered with OpenCode to help affected users who also use the OpenAI API restore services and refund API quotas consumed during the attack. 10 月 19 日，OpenAI 的 Codex 与 ChatGPT 团队成员 Tibo Sottiaux 表示，团队已与 OpenCode 合作，帮助同时使用 OpenAI API 的受影响用户恢复服务，并退还攻击期间被消耗的 API 额度。

OpenCode previously disclosed that a security incident related to a large-scale model distillation attack affected 1.4% of Console users, specifically some users who had previously linked external model service providers in the cloud. The team stated that they have sent emails individually and are collaborating with Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google for resolution. OpenCode 此前公开披露，一次与大规模模型蒸馏攻击有关的安全事件影响了 1.4% 的 Console 用户，受影响范围是曾在云端关联外部模型服务商的部分用户。团队称已逐一发送邮件，并与 Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Google 合作处置。

Sottiaux also stated that security teams can apply for Daybreak Blue in advance, using model configurations for defensive tasks with relaxed cybersecurity restrictions, without having to wait until an incident occurs to apply. Dax Raad, co-founder of OpenCode, replied below the post, stating that Daybreak played a crucial role in this defense and is currently still running. Sottiaux 还表示，安全团队可以提前申请 Daybreak Blue，使用面向防御任务、放宽部分网络安全限制的模型配置，无须等到事件发生后才申请。OpenCode 联合创始人 Dax Raad 在帖下回复，称 Daybreak 在此次防御中发挥了关键作用，目前仍在持续运行。

This refund statement targets affected OpenAI API customers, and its scope has not been extended to all third-party model accounts. 这次退款表态针对受影响的 OpenAI API 客户，范围并未扩展到所有第三方模型账户。

item.title: 「海面漂满 iPhone」视频系 AI 编造，原账号已标注 AI 内容
item.guid: 「海面漂满-iPhone」视频系-AI-编造，原账号已标注-AI-内容
item.description:
Recently, videos claiming that "after a shipwreck in the Strait of Hormuz, the sea was filled with iPhones and French perfumes" have been circulating on social media platforms. A verification report by Red Star News pointed out that the relevant images are AI-generated fictional content, and some videos can be traced back to the Instagram account Nativora, where the creator has already added an "AI Content" label. 近日，声称「霍尔木兹海峡沉船后，海面漂满 iPhone 和法国香水」的视频在社交平台流传。红星新闻的核查报道指出，相关影像是 AI 生成的虚构内容，部分视频最早可追溯至 Instagram 账号 Nativora，创作者已添加「AI Content」标识。

Investigators found the original account through reverse image search. The video itself also has several anomalies: the text on the phone packaging boxes is distorted, the floating objects resemble plastic models, and the clothing of characters in the same scene shows a mix of winter and summer attire. 调查人员通过反向搜索找到原始账号。视频本身也有多处异常：手机包装盒文字扭曲，漂浮物形态像塑料模型，同一场景的人物衣着则出现冬装、夏装混杂。

The cargo ship accident and these "salvaged phone" images need to be viewed separately. The Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore previously reported that a Singaporean cargo ship was damaged, caught fire, and sank while passing through the Strait of Hormuz on October 13, with all 21 crew members safely evacuated. The occurrence of the accident does not prove the authenticity of the circulated cargo images. 货轮事故与这些「打捞手机」影像需要分别看待。新加坡海事及港务管理局曾通报，一艘新加坡货轮在 10 月 13 日通过霍尔木兹海峡时受损起火并沉没，21 名船员安全撤离。事故发生并不能证明网传的货物画面真实。

item.title: 马斯克称明年将向美国每名儿童赠送一股本人持有的 SpaceX 股票
item.guid: 马斯克称明年将向美国每名儿童赠送一股本人持有的-SpaceX-股票
item.description:
Elon Musk posted on X on October 19, stating that he would give one share of his SpaceX stock to every child in the United States next year, writing: "This will be the first of many actions." According to the timing of his post, this commitment points to 2027. 马斯克 10 月 19 日在 X 发帖称，他将在明年向美国每名儿童赠送一股自己持有的 SpaceX 股票，并写道：「这将是诸多行动中的第一步。」按其帖文时间，这项承诺指向 2027 年。

What he promised is personal holdings, with the recipients described as "every child in the United States." According to a Business Insider report on the same day, SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell and her husband had previously pledged to donate SpaceX shares to over 2 million children. Musk has now publicly stated that he will use his own shares to join the donation. 他所承诺的是个人持股，接收对象表述为「美国的每个孩子」。据 Business Insider 同日报道，SpaceX 总裁 Gwynne Shotwell 与丈夫此前也曾承诺向超过 200 万名儿童赠予 SpaceX 股份。马斯克此次公开表示将动用自己的股份加入赠予行列。

item.title: 王腾宣布今日宜休将于 10 月 29 日举办首场发布会
item.guid: 王腾宣布今日宜休将于-10-月-29-日举办首场发布会
item.description:
Wang Teng announced on October 19 that ISHO Today's Rest (今日宜休) will hold an AI Sleep Technology Ecosystem Product Launch on October 29 at 19:00. This is Today's Rest's first product launch since its establishment. 王腾 10 月 19 日宣布，ISHO 今日宜休将于 10 月 29 日 19:00 举办 AI 睡眠科技生态产品发布会。这是今日宜休成立后的首场发布会。

Wang Teng stated on Weibo that the team has been preparing for this launch for a long time and invited users to "jointly seek new answers for sleep." Currently, the official has not yet announced the specific products and related information that will be launched at the event. 王腾在微博中表示，团队为这场发布会准备已久，并邀请用户一同「共寻睡眠新答案」。目前，官方尚未公布发布会将推出的具体产品及相关信息。

Wang Teng previously served as General Manager of Xiaomi China Marketing Department and General Manager of the REDMI brand, and announced the establishment of a new company, "Today's Rest" (今日宜休), earlier this year, primarily researching sleep health-related products. 王腾曾任小米中国区市场部总经理、REDMI 品牌总经理，并于今年年初宣布成立新公司「今日宜休」，主要研发睡眠健康相关产品。

item.title: 宇树将于 10 月 22 日举办物理 AI 大会，设置具身智能创投路演
item.guid: 宇树将于-10-月-22-日举办物理-AI-大会，设置具身智能创投路演
item.description:
Unitree Robotics will host the 2026 World Physical AI Conference and Unitree Partner Ecosystem Conference on October 22. According to a report by Huang Xinyi, a reporter from "STAR Market Daily," on October 19, the conference, themed "Advancing with Unitree, Growing Together," plans to welcome over 3,000 guests, featuring a main forum area of over 4,000 square meters and more than 40 exhibition zones. 宇树科技将于 10 月 22 日举办 2026 世界物理 AI 大会暨宇树合作伙伴生态大会。据《科创板日报》记者黄心怡 10 月 19 日报道，大会以「宇十俱进，树业共生」为主题，计划迎来 3000 余名嘉宾，设置 4000 余平方米的主论坛区域和 40 余个展示专区。

The "Embodied AI Venture Capital Sub-forum" in the afternoon will host project roadshows based on the "Unitree Innovation Plan," connecting startup projects with industry resources. The event will also feature a concentrated display of Unitree's full range of robot products and their applications in various scenarios. 当天下午的「具身智能创投分论坛」将依托「宇创计划」开展项目路演，连接创业项目与产业资源。现场还将集中展示宇树全系机器人产品及其在不同场景中的应用。

The conference has not yet taken place; what has been disclosed so far are the event schedule and exhibition plans. Specific products and cooperation progress are still awaiting on-site announcement. 大会尚未举行，目前披露的是活动安排和展示计划，具体产品与合作进展仍待现场公布。

item.title: Modal 将采用英伟达 Vera CPU，继续保留 Intel 与 AMD 机群
item.guid: Modal-将采用英伟达-Vera-CPU，继续保留-Intel-与-AMD-机群
item.description:
According to a Reuters report on October 19, cloud computing startup Modal plans to adopt Nvidia's Vera central processor for the first time to provide computing power for AI agents capable of continuously executing tasks. Previously, all of Modal's such workloads ran on Intel and AMD chips. 据路透社 10 月 19 日报道，云计算初创公司 Modal 计划首次采用英伟达 Vera 中央处理器，为能够持续执行任务的 AI 智能体提供算力。此前，Modal 的这类工作负载全部运行在 Intel 和 AMD 芯片上。

Modal stated that in early tests, Vera doubled the workload that agents could complete, leading the company to decide to adapt its underlying software for the Nvidia architecture. Modal 表示，早期测试中，Vera 让智能体能够完成的工作量翻倍，公司因此决定为英伟达架构进行底层软件适配。

CEO Erik Bernhardsson emphasized that the company will combine Vera with existing Intel and AMD products to form a hybrid cluster, allocating hardware based on the actual performance of different tasks. The tests compared Intel and AMD chips that were already on the market at the time; Modal will retest when the two companies release new models. 首席执行官 Erik Bernhardsson 强调，公司会把 Vera 与现有 Intel、AMD 产品组合成混合机群，按不同任务的实际表现分配硬件。测试对比的是当时已经上市的 Intel 和 AMD 芯片；待两家推出新型号，Modal 也会重新测试。

item.title: 引望与宁德时代签署换电合作协议，覆盖电池与换电网络
item.guid: 引望与宁德时代签署换电合作协议，覆盖电池与换电网络
item.description:
On October 19, intelligent automotive technology company Yinwang signed a strategic cooperation framework agreement with CATL and Times Electric Service. 10 月 19 日，智能汽车技术企业引望与宁德时代、时代电服签署战略合作框架协议。

The three parties proposed creating a seamless energy replenishment experience for the era of autonomous driving. Reuters reported, citing relevant statements, that the scope of cooperation includes swappable batteries and battery swapping networks. 三方提出打造面向自动驾驶时代的无感补能体验。路透社援引相关声明报道，合作范围包括可更换电池及换电网络。

According to Wall Street Insights' report on the signing news, the three parties will cooperate around the intelligent battery swapping ecosystem, with Yinwang officially joining CATL's Chocolate battery swapping ecosystem. CATL Chairman Zeng Yuqun, Yinwang CEO Jin Yuzhi, and CATL Co-President of Market System Yang Jun, among others, attended the signing ceremony. 据华尔街见闻对签约消息的报道，三方将围绕智能换电生态开展合作，引望正式加入宁德时代巧克力换电生态。宁德时代董事长曾毓群、引望 CEO 靳玉志及宁德时代市场体系联席总裁杨峻等出席签约。

item.title: Nscale 与 Anthropic 洽谈 450 亿美元新算力交易，涉及第二座 Monarch 设施
item.guid: Nscale-与-Anthropic-洽谈-450-亿美元新算力交易，涉及第二座-Monarch-设施
item.description:
According to a Reuters report on October 19, Nscale is negotiating a potential AI computing power deal worth approximately $45 billion with Anthropic, with services to be provided by the second facility at the Monarch data center park in West Virginia, USA. 据路透社 10 月 19 日报道，Nscale 正与 Anthropic 商谈一笔可能价值约 450 亿美元的 AI 算力交易，拟由美国西弗吉尼亚州 Monarch 数据中心园区的第二座设施提供服务。

Sources said the facility will use Nvidia Vera Rubin AI chips, providing 460 megawatts of computing power. Anthropic also holds a right of first refusal for a third facility planned for construction in the park; negotiations are ongoing, and terms may change. 知情人士称，这座设施将采用英伟达 Vera Rubin AI 芯片，提供 460 兆瓦算力。Anthropic 还持有园区计划建设的第三座设施的优先购买权；谈判仍在进行，条款可能变化。

This will be another collaboration between the two parties at Monarch. In August, Anthropic reached a $45 billion computing power lease agreement; this negotiation is for the second facility and should not be considered the same transaction as the previous agreement. 这将是双方在 Monarch 的另一笔合作。今年 8 月，Anthropic 已达成一项价值 450 亿美元的算力租赁协议，本次商谈针对第二座设施，不能与此前协议视为同一笔交易。

Reuters also mentioned that Microsoft recently withdrew from another flagship data center collaboration with Nscale due to power access delays, with the project's expected power supply date pushed back to the 2030s. 路透社同时提到，微软近期因电力接入延误退出了 Nscale 的另一项旗舰数据中心合作，该项目预计供电时间已被推迟至 2030 年代。

item.title: Netflix 电影负责人 Dan Lin 离职
item.guid: Netflix-电影负责人-Dan-Lin-离职
item.description:
According to Deadline's report on October 19, Dan Lin, head of Netflix's film business, has resigned. Both Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos and Lin provided statements to the media confirming the change. 据 Deadline 10 月 19 日报道，Netflix 电影业务负责人 Dan Lin 已离职。Netflix 联席 CEO Ted Sarandos 与 Lin 均向媒体提供了声明，确认这一变动。

Lin succeeded Scott Stuber in 2024, having run the production company Rideback before joining Netflix. During his tenure, he pushed for a reduction in high-cost film projects. In his statement, Sarandos thanked him for his contributions to film quality, deal strategy, and team collaboration; Lin, in turn, thanked the team, creators, and management. Lin 于 2024 年接替 Scott Stuber，进入 Netflix 前经营制片公司 Rideback。他在任期间推动减少高成本电影项目。Sarandos 在声明中感谢他对电影质量、交易策略及团队协作的贡献；Lin 则感谢团队、创作者和管理层。

According to sources, the successor will be decided after Peter Rice takes office. Rice will succeed Bela Bajaria as Netflix's Chief Content Officer on October 26. Previously, another executive from the film division, Doug Belgrad, had also left. 据知情人士透露，继任者将等 Peter Rice 到任后再决定。Rice 将于 10 月 26 日接替 Bela Bajaria，出任 Netflix 首席内容官。此前电影部门另一名高管 Doug Belgrad 也已离开。

This round of changes comes as Netflix adjusts its content management team. Deadline states that the interview process for Lin's successor has not yet begun. 这轮变动发生在 Netflix 调整内容管理层之际。Deadline 称，目前尚未启动 Lin 继任者的面试程序。

item.title: 李想：车企与电池供应商要「两条腿交替前进」
item.guid: 李想：车企与电池供应商要「两条腿交替前进」
item.description:
On October 19, Li Xiang, CEO of Li Auto, posted that in-depth research into core battery technology by automotive OEMs is beneficial for industry development and consumer interests. 10 月 19 日，理想汽车 CEO 李想发文表示，汽车主机厂深入研究电池核心技术，有利于行业发展和消费者利益。

He cited the personal computer industry as an example: Apple insisted on self-developed operating systems, later launched the M-series chips, and after integrating software and hardware, Mac's fluidity, battery life, and heat dissipation all improved; meanwhile, professional suppliers such as Microsoft, Intel, and AMD also worked with PC manufacturers to advance Windows computers. 他以个人电脑行业为例：苹果坚持自研操作系统，后来推出 M 系列芯片，软硬件打通后，Mac 的流畅度、续航和散热都有提升；与此同时，微软、英特尔和 AMD 等专业供应商也与电脑厂商一起推动 Windows 电脑进步。

Li Xiang believes that hyperscale industries require collaboration between two types of enterprises: professional suppliers who deeply understand the product, and complete machine manufacturers who deeply research core technologies. If the industry relies solely on one party for a long time, it easily falls into scale competition, while performance, quality, safety, and longevity, which users care about, stagnate. 李想认为，超大规模产业需要两类企业协作：深入理解产品的专业供应商，以及深入研究核心技术的整机厂商。长期只依靠一方，行业容易陷入规模竞争，用户在意的性能、质量、安全和寿命反而停滞。

Speaking about Li Auto itself, he stated that the company decided to self-develop batteries in 2020, hoping to advance technology with partners, starting from vehicle and user needs. He emphasized that which parts to do in-house and which to collaborate with partners are choices made at different stages, and the criterion for judgment is which method is better for the user. 谈到理想自身，他表示，公司在 2020 年决定自研电池，希望从整车和用户需求出发，与合作伙伴一起推进技术。他强调，哪些环节自己做、哪些与伙伴合作，是不同阶段的选择，判断标准是哪种方式对用户更好。

What we want to do is become the type of enterprise that understands batteries best, and together with battery suppliers who understand cars best, push forward long-unresolved problems.

The Li Auto Power Day electric technology launch event is scheduled for October 20 at 19:30. 理想 Power Day 电动技术发布会定于 10 月 20 日 19:30 举行。

item.title: 斯巴鲁拟统一电子架构，将整车开发周期缩短约 40%
item.guid: 斯巴鲁拟统一电子架构，将整车开发周期缩短约-40%
item.description:
According to Reuters, Subaru held a strategy briefing at its R&D center in Sano City, Japan, planning to launch software-defined vehicles in the latter half of this decade and shorten the overall vehicle development cycle by approximately 40%. 据路透社报道，斯巴鲁在日本佐野市研发中心举行战略说明会，计划在本十年后半段推出软件定义汽车，并将整车开发周期缩短约 40%。

Subaru will gradually deploy newly developed integrated Electronic Control Units (ECUs) across all its models, with core chips jointly developed with AMD. Pure electric, hybrid, and fuel-powered models will adopt a unified electronic platform architecture, aiming to upgrade driving assistance, autonomous driving, and overall vehicle performance-related functions via OTA updates. 斯巴鲁将逐步在全系车型部署新开发的集成电子控制单元（ECU），核心芯片由其与 AMD 联合开发。纯电、混动和燃油车型将采用统一的电子平台架构，目标是通过 OTA 升级驾驶辅助、自动驾驶和整车性能相关功能。

The R&D process will also be adjusted: digital simulation will be used during the prototype development phase, and design, testing, and production preparation will be carried out in parallel to accelerate new vehicle launches. Subaru also stated that it currently has no plans to adopt Toyota's Arene software platform. 研发流程也将调整：在原型开发阶段使用数字仿真，并行开展设计、测试与生产准备，以加快新车投放。斯巴鲁同时表示，目前没有采用丰田 Arene 软件平台的计划。

item.title: Tenstorrent 完成 15 亿美元融资，投后估值达 62 亿美元
item.guid: Tenstorrent-完成-15-亿美元融资，投后估值达-62-亿美元
item.description:
Tenstorrent announced the completion of a $1.5 billion Series E funding round, valuing the company at $6.2 billion post-money. This round was led by Trace Capital and Innovation X, with participation from ARK Invest, Fidelity, Morgan Stanley, Sandisk, and Tether Investments, among others. Tenstorrent 宣布完成 15 亿美元 E 轮融资，投后估值为 62 亿美元。本轮由 Trace Capital 与 Innovation X 领投，参投方包括 ARK Invest、Fidelity、Morgan Stanley、Sandisk 和 Tether Investments 等。

This AI computing company, led by Jim Keller, will use the funds for large-scale deployment of Galaxy servers, supporting open-weight large language models and video generation models, and continuing to advance its externally licensed AI and CPU IP businesses. 这家由 Jim Keller 领导的 AI 计算公司，将把资金用于大规模部署 Galaxy 服务器，支持开放权重的大语言模型和视频生成模型，并继续推进对外授权的 AI 与 CPU IP 业务。

Tenstorrent's products cover single compute cards, workstations, racks, superclusters, and custom IP, accompanied by an open-source software stack. It sells computing equipment and also provides technology licensing to customers who design their own chips. Keller stated that the company hopes to cover different scales of computing needs with the same architecture. Tenstorrent 的产品覆盖单张计算卡、工作站、机架、超级集群和定制 IP，配套开源软件栈，既销售计算设备，也向自行设计芯片的客户提供技术授权。Keller 表示，公司希望用同一套架构覆盖不同规模的计算需求。

item.title: 💡 杨立昆锐评特斯拉会飞超跑，马斯克用「放屁」回应质疑
item.guid: 💡-杨立昆锐评特斯拉会飞超跑，马斯克用「放屁」回应质疑
item.description:
Yesterday, Elon Musk posted on X, saying: 'I farted in your general direction 💨', in response to Yann LeCun's previous skepticism regarding his 'flying car' related demonstration. 昨天，埃隆·马斯克在 X 上发文称：「我朝你大致的方向放了个屁 💨」，回应 Yann LeCun 此前对其「会飞的汽车」相关演示的质疑。

LeCun then used the metaphor of 'high-pressure abdomen' to jokingly suggest that such 'farting' might propel people upwards and forwards, likening the car's propulsion principle to a 'loud fart' with a pressure of 700 bar, a volume of 600 liters, lasting for 3 seconds. LeCun 随后以「高压腹部」为比喻，调侃称这种「放屁」或许能让人向上、向前推进，并将汽车的推进原理类比为一个压力达 700 bar、容量 600 升、持续 3 秒的「响屁」。

This interaction stemmed from a video previously posted by Musk. He stated that flying cars would indeed appear in the future. 这场互动源于马斯克此前发布的一段视频。他表示，未来确实会出现飞行汽车。

LeCun believes that the vehicle in the video relies on compressed air propulsion. Although it may provide acceleration in different directions for a short period, and even hover for a few seconds if a 400-liter high-pressure air tank replaces the passenger seat, it cannot be a technical path for a true flying car. LeCun 则认为，视频中的车辆依靠压缩空气推进，虽然可能在短时间内提供不同方向的加速度，甚至在用一个 400 升高压储气罐替代乘客座椅的情况下悬浮数秒，但并不能成为真正飞行汽车的技术路径。

LeCun also stated that even if compressed air accounts for half of the vehicle's total mass, the available thrust time might be less than 10 seconds, and more likely only about 5 seconds. LeCun 还称，即使压缩空气占车辆总质量的一半，可用推力时间也可能不足 10 秒，更可能只有约 5 秒。

He stated that he does not oppose Musk's real achievements, and even owns two Teslas, but he questions marketing demonstrations that "look cool on the surface but are not actually the achievements claimed in the promotion." 他表示，自己并不反对马斯克取得的真实成就，甚至拥有两辆特斯拉，但会质疑那些「表面上很酷、实际并非宣传所称成就」的营销演示。

🔗 Related Reading: Can a Tesla only fly for 5 seconds? Scientists call it a "fart car," FAA: Does not meet the definition of an aircraft 🔗 相关阅读： 特斯拉只能飞 5 秒？科学家称其为「放屁车」，联邦航空局：不符合航空器定义

item.title: 腾讯 WorkBuddy 教育公益版上线，教师每月可领 2000 积分
item.guid: 腾讯-WorkBuddy-教育公益版上线，教师每月可领-2000-积分
item.description:
On October 19, Tencent SSV announced the official launch of WorkBuddy Education Public Welfare Edition, open to teachers nationwide. After activation, each teacher can receive 2000 points per month, continuously supported for 12 months, without regional or academic stage restrictions. 10 月 19 日，腾讯 SSV 宣布 WorkBuddy 教育公益版正式上线，面向全国教师开放。开通后，每位教师每月可领取 2000 积分，连续支持 12 个月，不限地区和学段。

Tencent SSV and the WorkBuddy team have developed an AI teaching assistant for teachers, and collaborated with universities such as Peking University and Beijing Normal University to transform research results in teaching design, open class refinement, differentiated instruction, home-school communication, and student psychology into callable educational expert modules, which will be launched successively. 腾讯 SSV 与 WorkBuddy 团队围绕教师工作制作了 AI 教学助理，并联合北京大学、北京师范大学等高校，将教学设计、公开课打磨、分层教学、家校沟通和学生心理等研究成果转为可调用的教育专家模块，相关模块将陆续上线。

The product also provides tools for creative teaching, script-based classrooms, courseware production, animation demonstrations, and material processing. Teachers can describe their teaching needs using natural language, generate a draft, and then continue to modify it. Subsequent plans include integrating Tencent Docs, Lexiang Knowledge Base, and ima to connect the knowledge base and collaborative editing into the workflow. 产品还提供创意教学、剧本课堂、课件制作、动画演示和素材加工等工具。教师可以用自然语言描述教学需求，生成初稿后继续修改。后续计划打通腾讯文档、乐享知识库和 ima，把资料库与协同编辑接入工作流。

Teachers can access the application portal from the "Tencent SSV" WeChat official account menu, fill in identity information, and activate within 3 working days after approval. Points are replenished on the 1st of each month, and the free model can still be used after points are exhausted. 教师可从「腾讯 SSV」微信公众号菜单进入申领入口，填写身份信息，审核通过后 3 个工作日内开通。积分每月 1 日补满，耗尽后仍可使用免费模型。

item.title: 商务部：前 9 月重点平台智能眼镜销售额增长 1.1 倍
item.guid: 商务部：前-9-月重点平台智能眼镜销售额增长-1.1-倍
item.description:
On October 19, Yuan Xiaoming, Assistant Minister of Commerce, stated at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office that commercial big data shows that from January to September this year, sales of smart glasses on key platforms increased by 1.1 times. This data counts sales on key platforms and does not disclose national sales or shipments. 10 月 19 日，商务部部长助理袁晓明在国新办新闻发布会上表示，商务大数据显示，今年 1—9 月，重点平台智能眼镜销售额增长 1.1 倍。这项数据统计的是重点平台的销售金额，未披露全国销量或出货量。

The Ministry of Commerce and 9 other departments recently issued the "Opinions on Accelerating the Promotion of Technology-Driven Business Development," proposing to enrich the supply of smart products such as smartphones, computers, home appliances, wearables, and robots, and to expand the application of commercial intelligent agents and embodied intelligence in scenarios such as home services and commercial logistics. 商务部等 9 部门近日发布《关于加快推进科技兴商的意见》，提出丰富智能手机、电脑、家居、穿戴设备和机器人等智能商品供给，拓展商业智能体和具身智能在家庭服务、商贸物流等场景中的应用。

The document also proposes cultivating quality e-commerce, exploring a "first authenticate, then ship" model, strengthening online verification for key product e-commerce platforms, and promoting the establishment of national standards for intelligent grading of AI terminals in fields such as home appliances. Yuan Xiaoming stated that the policy integrates technological innovation into the entire commercial chain from supply and circulation to consumption. 文件还提出培育品质电商，探索「先鉴别、后发货」模式，加强重点产品电商平台联网核查，并推动家电等领域建立人工智能终端智能化分级国家标准。袁晓明表示，政策将科技创新融入从供给、流通到消费的商贸全链条。

item.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash 上线：推理提速近 3 倍，Agent 任务成本降 70%
item.guid: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-上线：推理提速近-3-倍，Agent-任务成本降-70%
item.description:
MiniMax officially launched M3.1 Flash and confirmed that Space Bunny, which previously ran anonymously and processed over 200T Tokens, was its early version. The new model has been integrated into MiniMax API, MPlan, and MiniMax Code, with weights to be released later. MiniMax 正式上线 M3.1 Flash，并确认此前匿名运行、累计处理超过 200T Token 的 Space Bunny「太空兔」是其早期版本。新模型已进入 MiniMax API、MPlan 和 MiniMax Code，权重将在稍后开放。

According to the official statement, M3.1 Flash's online inference speed has increased by nearly 3 times, and the overall usage cost for Agent-type tasks has decreased by 70% compared to its predecessor. The input price per million tokens is 1 yuan, output is 4 yuan, and cache reading is 0.1 yuan; in daily use scenarios, the output speed can reach over 200 tokens per second, with a median stable at over 170 tokens per second. 官方称，M3.1 Flash 的线上推理速度提升近 3 倍，Agent 类任务的综合使用成本较前代降低 70%。每百万 Token 的输入价格为 1 元、输出为 4 元，缓存读取为 0.1 元；日常使用场景输出速度可达每秒 200 Token 以上，中位数稳定在每秒 170 Token 以上。

Capability updates primarily focus on cross-application automation, programming, computer operation, and cybersecurity. According to evaluations released by the team, the model achieved 73.7% in DeepSWE v1.1, 61.7 points in OSWorld V2, and 82% in CyberGym. MiniMax also announced that a Pro version, aiming for a higher capability ceiling, will be launched later. 能力更新主要集中在跨应用自动化、编程、电脑操作和网络安全。按团队公布的评测，模型在 DeepSWE v1.1 中取得 73.7%，OSWorld V2 为 61.7 分，CyberGym 为 82%。MiniMax 同时预告，追求更高能力上限的 Pro 版本也将在稍后推出。

item.title: 《海岛大亨 7》免费 Demo 上线，支持简体中文语音
item.guid: 《海岛大亨-7》免费-Demo-上线，支持简体中文语音
item.description:
Kalypso Media's new simulation management series game, "Tropico 7," has released a free demo on Steam, supporting simplified Chinese interface, voice, and subtitles. The game is developed by Gaming Minds Studios, and the Chinese store page shows a planned release date of January 29, 2027. Kalypso Media 旗下模拟经营系列新作《海岛大亨 7》已在 Steam 开放免费 Demo，支持简体中文界面、语音和字幕。游戏由 Gaming Minds Studios 开发，中文区商店显示计划于 2027 年 1 月 29 日发售。

This game continues to let players assume the role of an island leader, managing cities, handling elections and diplomacy, and for the first time, flattening mountains, creating beaches, and even building new islands through a terrain transformation system. The council system allows players to convene different factions for negotiations, and the revamped military system enables more direct command of troops. 本作继续让玩家扮演岛屿领袖，经营城市、处理选举和外交，并首次通过地形改造系统抹平山脉、制造沙滩乃至建造新岛屿。议会系统允许玩家召集不同派系谈判，重制后的军事系统则可更直接地指挥部队。

The full game includes 5 campaign maps, introduces a new opponent, Victoria Guerra, and offers 10 additional scenarios, over 20 sandbox maps, and a random map generator. The minimum PC requirements are 16GB RAM, an RTX 2060 or RX 5600 XT level graphics card, and 40GB of available storage space. 完整游戏包含 5 张战役地图，新增对手维多利亚·格拉，并提供 10 个额外场景、20 多张沙盒地图和随机地图生成器。PC 最低配置要求 16GB 内存、RTX 2060 或 RX 5600 XT 级别显卡，以及 40GB 可用存储空间。

item.title: 中国电信开源 Xing4.0-29B-Intent，把口语指令转为结构化信息
item.guid: 中国电信开源-Xing4.0-29B-Intent，把口语指令转为结构化信息
item.description:
China Telecom AI Technology Co., Ltd.'s Star General Artificial Intelligence Lab has released and open-sourced Xing4.0-29B-Intent, providing model weights, code, and approximately 2.75 million training corpora. The model is based on a 29B mixture-of-experts architecture, with about 4B active parameters, designed for intent recognition and structured information extraction. 中电信人工智能科技有限公司星辰通用人工智能实验室发布并开源 Xing4.0-29B-Intent，提供模型权重、代码和约 275 万条训练语料。模型基于 29B 的混合专家架构，激活参数约 4B，面向意图识别和结构化信息抽取。

It converts natural language into JSON according to the categories and field rules provided by developers. For example, for "Help me find tomorrow's flight from Beijing to Shanghai," the output needs to identify the intent of querying a flight and extract the origin, destination, and date. The model also supports multiple intents and parameters within a single sentence. 它会按照开发者给定的类别与字段规则，将自然语言转成 JSON。例如「帮我查明天北京到上海的航班」，输出既要识别查询航班的意图，也要抽取出发地、目的地和日期。模型还支持一句话中的多个意图和多个参数。

The same "category + parameter" format covers intent understanding, entity recognition, relation extraction, and event extraction. The accompanying dataset covers 61 public datasets, 19 domains, and 52 languages; an official Python SDK is also provided, supporting access to OpenAI API-compatible model services. 同一套「类别＋参数」格式覆盖意图理解、实体识别、关系抽取与事件抽取。配套数据集覆盖 61 个公开数据集、19 个领域和 52 种语言；官方同时提供 Python SDK，支持接入兼容 OpenAI API 的模型服务。

Project code, weights, and public data are licensed under Apache 2.0. Officially, the model has been used for intent recognition, ticket routing for telecom's customer service, and smart home speaker command parsing. 项目代码、权重和公开数据采用 Apache 2.0 许可。官方介绍，模型已用于电信万号客服的意图识别、工单路由及智能家居音箱指令解析。

item.title: EFF 将 Privacy Badger 带到 Mac 版 Safari，可阻止隐藏追踪器加载
item.guid: EFF-将-Privacy-Badger-带到-Mac-版-Safari，可阻止隐藏追踪器加载
item.description:
The Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF) announced on October 19 that its anti-tracking extension, Privacy Badger, is now available for Safari on macOS, offered for free and requiring Safari 26.5 or later. 电子前哨基金会（EFF）10 月 19 日宣布，反追踪扩展 Privacy Badger 已登陆 macOS 上的 Safari，免费提供，要求 Safari 26.5 或更高版本。

EFF stated that Safari by default limits the information trackers can obtain but still allows them to load; Privacy Badger, however, directly blocks identified online trackers from loading, complementing the browser's existing privacy protections. The extension automatically learns to identify hidden trackers to reduce cross-site user information collection by data brokers and ad tech companies. EFF 表示，Safari 默认会限制追踪器能够获取的信息，但仍允许它们加载；Privacy Badger 则会直接阻止识别出的在线追踪器加载，补充浏览器已有的隐私保护。扩展会自动学习识别隐藏追踪器，以减少数据经纪商和广告技术公司跨站收集用户信息。

Privacy Badger previously supported Chrome, Edge, and Firefox. EFF stated that Safari was one of the platforms long requested by users, and with its launch, the tool now covers major desktop browsers; the total number of users across all platforms exceeds 4 million. Privacy Badger 此前已支持 Chrome、Edge 和 Firefox。EFF 称，Safari 是用户长期要求支持的平台之一，此次上线后，这款工具已覆盖主要桌面浏览器；所有平台的用户总数超过 400 万。

item.title: 星巴克中国否认「消费才可入座」，部分门店拟摆提示牌
item.guid: 星巴克中国否认「消费才可入座」，部分门店拟摆提示牌
item.description:
Regarding the news that 'Starbucks will implement a policy requiring consumption to be seated starting October 20,' Starbucks China responded to Blue Whale News, stating: 'It is not true.' 针对「星巴克将于 10 月 20 日实施消费才可入座」的消息，星巴克中国向蓝鲸新闻回应称：「不属实。」

This discussion originated from materials circulating on social media, including the 'Starbucks "Third Place" Initiative' and 'Please Consume to Be Seated' table cards. When Jiupai News visited stores, some staff members said they had received new rules, suggesting customers use seats after making a purchase, but it wouldn't be a blanket rule; those with temporary needs, such as pregnant women, delivery riders, or people seeking shelter from rain, could still rest briefly and get hot water. 这次讨论源于社交平台流传的《星巴克「第三空间」倡议》物料及「请消费入座」桌牌。九派新闻走访门店时，有店员称收到了新规则，建议顾客消费后使用座位，但不会一刀切；孕妇、外卖员、避雨路人等有临时需求者仍可短暂休息，并可获得热水。

A Jiemian News reporter inquired at a store in Beijing's East Fourth Ring Road, and a staff member also stated that they had received the table cards and planned to display them on October 20; another staff member said that when seats are full, they might remind those occupying seats for a long time without reason, but ordinary short breaks or waiting for someone would not require being forced to buy coffee. 界面新闻记者询问北京东四环一家门店，店员也表示已收到桌牌，计划 10 月 20 日摆放；另一位店员称，座位客满时可能提醒无故长时间占座的人，普通短暂休息、等人无需被强制要求买咖啡。

item.title: 汇源集团停产带「汇源」商标的果汁，启用「咱家果源」
item.guid: 汇源集团停产带「汇源」商标的果汁，启用「咱家果源」
item.description:
On October 19, Beijing Huiyuan Beverage and Food Group Co., Ltd. issued a statement and confirmed to a Shanghai Securities News reporter that the group and its subsidiaries would cease production and OEM of juice products bearing the 'Huiyuan' trademark, terminate relevant OEM contracts, and transfer the business to a new brand, 'Zanjia Guoyuan'. 10 月 19 日，北京汇源饮料食品集团有限公司发布声明，并向上海证券报记者确认，集团及下属企业将停止生产、代工带有「汇源」商标的果汁产品，终止相关代工合同，改由新品牌「咱家果源」承接业务。

This adjustment involves the brand and operational relationship between Huiyuan Group and the reorganized Beijing Huiyuan Food and Beverage Co., Ltd. 这次调整涉及汇源集团与重整后的北京汇源食品饮料有限公司之间的品牌及经营关系。

Huiyuan Group stated that because the restructuring investor, Shanghai Wensheng, failed to fulfill its agreement, Beijing Huiyuan has effectively detached from the group's entire industrial chain system, and the group will continue to pursue relevant legal procedures. 汇源集团称，因重整投资人上海文盛未履行约定，北京汇源已事实上脱离集团全产业链体系，集团将继续推进相关法律程序。

Huiyuan Group stated that it still holds physical assets such as orchards, production bases, and supply chains, and the new brand will continue to operate the juice business relying on these resources. 汇源集团表示，自己仍持有果园、生产基地及供应链等实业资产，新品牌将依托这些资源继续经营果汁业务。

item.title: 延尚昊新片《Paradise Lost》售至 118 个市场，韩国 10 月 21 日上映
item.guid: 延尚昊新片《Paradise-Lost》售至-118-个市场，韩国-10-月-21-日上映
item.description:
According to Deadline, 'Paradise Lost,' a psychological thriller directed by Yeon Sang-ho, director of 'Train to Busan,' has been sold to 118 countries and regions and will have its U.S. premiere at the Hawaii International Film Festival. 据 Deadline 报道，《釜山行》导演延尚昊执导的心理惊悚片《Paradise Lost》已售至 118 个国家和地区，并将在夏威夷国际电影节举行美国首映。

Starring Kim Hyun-joo and Bae Hyun-sung, the film tells the story of a mother who, nine years after her son's disappearance, finds him suddenly alive. That year, a bus carrying children to a camp mysteriously vanished, and the mother had long believed her son to be dead. 影片由金贤珠、裴贤圣主演，讲述一位母亲在儿子失踪九年后，等到他突然生还的故事。当年，一辆载着孩子前往营地的巴士神秘消失，母亲早已认定儿子死亡。

The film was previously screened at the Toronto and Busan Film Festivals, with Hawaii screenings scheduled for November 1 and 4. Distributor CJ ENM stated that overseas sales revenue has exceeded the film's net production budget. Distribution rights for Japan, France, and North America were acquired by Twin, The Jokers Films, and Well Go USA, respectively. 影片此前在多伦多和釜山电影节放映，夏威夷场次定于 11 月 1 日和 4 日。发行方 CJ ENM 称，海外销售收入已超过影片的净制作预算。日本、法国和北美发行权分别由 Twin、The Jokers Films 和 Well Go USA 取得。

'Paradise Lost' will be released in South Korea on October 21, in Taiwan on October 23, in Singapore on November 5, and in North America on November 6. 《Paradise Lost》将于 10 月 21 日在韩国上映，10 月 23 日登陆中国台湾，11 月 5 日在新加坡上映，北美档期为 11 月 6 日。

item.title: 《足球教练》主创愿拍第 5、6 季，编剧室尚未启动
item.guid: 《足球教练》主创愿拍第-5、6-季，编剧室尚未启动
item.description:
After the conclusion of 'Ted Lasso' Season 4 this month, creator and star Jason Sudeikis discussed the possibility of continuing the show on the podcast 'Talk Easy with Sam Fragoso'. 《足球教练》（Ted Lasso）第 4 季本月结束后，主创兼主演杰森·苏戴奇斯在播客《Talk Easy with Sam Fragoso》中谈到了继续拍摄的可能。

When asked by the host if he had plans for seasons 5 and 6, he stated that when he decided to return for season 4, he did feel there was more to tell in the story, but subsequent seasons would require a team effort. When directly asked if he was willing to continue, he replied: 'I would, I think it would be fun.' 主持人问他是否已有第 5、6 季的规划，他表示，决定重返第 4 季时，确实觉得这个故事还有内容可讲，但后续需要团队共同完成。当被直接问到是否愿意继续，他回答：「我愿意，我觉得会很有趣。」

Sudeikis also clarified that it's currently unknown if further seasons will happen, and the team has not yet formed a writers' room. He speculated that if he decided to continue, Apple would likely be willing to collaborate. 苏戴奇斯同时明确表示，目前还不知道后续是否会成行，团队尚未成立编剧室。他推测，如果自己决定继续，Apple 应该也愿意合作。

9to5Mac published this conversation on October 19. Sudeikis's statements revealed a willingness to continue creating, but he did not announce a renewal or provide production or release dates for a next season. 9to5Mac 10 月 19 日刊出了这段对话。苏戴奇斯的表态透露出继续创作的意愿，但没有宣布续订，也没有给出下一季的制作或上线日期。

item.title: 乔恩·斯图尔特续约《每日秀》至 2028 年，继续轮值主持与执行制片
item.guid: 乔恩·斯图尔特续约《每日秀》至-2028-年，继续轮值主持与执行制片
item.description:
According to Variety on October 19, Jon Stewart has signed a two-year contract extension with Comedy Central, continuing his involvement with 'The Daily Show' until 2028, covering the next U.S. presidential election cycle. His previous contract was originally set to expire at the end of this year. 据 Variety 10 月 19 日报道，乔恩·斯图尔特与 Comedy Central 续签两年合约，将继续参与《每日秀》至 2028 年，覆盖下一届美国总统大选周期。他上一份合约原定于今年年底到期。

After the renewal, Stewart continues to rotate as host with Ronny Chieng, Josh Johnson, Jordan Klepper, Michael Kosta, and Desi Lydic, among others, while also serving as executive producer, collaborating with showrunner Jen Flanz and longtime agent James Dixon. 续约后，斯图尔特继续与 Ronny Chieng、Josh Johnson、Jordan Klepper、Michael Kosta 和 Desi Lydic 等人轮值主持，同时担任执行制片人，与节目统筹 Jen Flanz 及长期经纪人 James Dixon 合作。

Stewart began hosting the satirical news program in 1999, left in 2015, and returned in February 2024. During his absence, the hosting duties were handed over to Trevor Noah. 斯图尔特自 1999 年开始主持这档讽刺新闻节目，2015 年离开，2024 年 2 月回归。其间主持棒曾交给 Trevor Noah。

According to data provided by Paramount, "The Daily Show" was the most-watched cable TV program on social media in 2026. This renewal comes weeks after Paramount and Warner Bros. completed their merger, with the show continuing to maintain its rotating host lineup. 按照派拉蒙提供的数据，《每日秀》是 2026 年社交媒体上观看量最高的有线电视节目。此次续约发生在派拉蒙与华纳兄弟完成合并数周后，节目继续保留轮值主持阵容。
